address_quote: We are in the heart of downtown Fort Thomas, KY at 1 Highland Ave Suite A

facts.claim: The café offers mobile ordering through its Order tab. The FAQ does not specify curbside handoff or carrying assistance; check collection arrangements before ordering.
facts.quote: Yes, we offer mobile ordering. Head to the order tab on this website, then order online. You are all set!

facts.claim: Wi-Fi and laptop use are welcome for paying customers. This is a shared café space, not a promise of quiet conditions.
facts.quote: Yes, we have Wi-Fi and are laptop friendly. Our space can be used for studying, business work, dates, meeting with friends, etc. We just ask that upon using our Wi-Fi, you are a paying customer!

facts.claim: The venue describes its closed-door coworking space as quiet, but access requires a day pass ($25 advertised) or Tower Membership and is available only when the Cannon Event Suite is not rented. Walk-ins are welcome; seats may be reserved online up to one week ahead, with priority for business off-sites and event rentals.
quote: Buy a Day Pass or become a Tower Member to access our quiet, closed-door co-work space when the Cannon Event Suite is not rented.
Walk-Ins are welcome. Seats can be reserved online up to one week in advance. Priority booking is reserved for business off-sites and event rentals.

facts.claim: The meeting and event business center advertises complimentary parking and food and drink service directly to the table. This service description does not establish accessible parking bays, a step-free entrance or personal assistance; check the room and route when booking.
facts.quote: Fort Thomas Connect offers complimentary parking, exceptional hospitality, and a full food and beverage menu with direct-to-table service

facts.claim: The FAQ lists 6:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 6:30 a.m.–2 p.m. Sunday, with 859-999-8080 for questions. Check current hours and any event arrangements before travel.
